Recipient acceptance compares authenticated account email, normalized by IAM convention, to immutable invitation.invitedEmail; no target Organization context is required. Strict allowlist; no-store. New mutation revalidates authority/CAS; exact committed replay reauthorizes then returns original ack before new-attempt version/state/expiry checks. post.summary: Invite an email address, whether or not it has an account
post.description: EMAIL-BOUND V3 contract; runtime NOT_IMPLEMENTED on main until the paired implementation is merged. Current ACTIVE Organization ADMIN with organization.memberships.manage may invite a normalized email using email and reasonCode; no User ID is accepted. Creating an invitation creates no User or Membership. Invitation, idempotency result, allowlisted audit, and encrypted email-delivery outbox intent commit atomically. The API returns after commit and does not wait for SMTP; the response means queued for delivery, not sent. A7 provider delivery is asynchronous. A8 remains an operational rollout concern. The persistent invitation record stores only a one-way token hash; the encrypted outbox token is removed after delivery or terminal failure. Acceptance derives normalized email from the authenticated principal and denies mismatch. No generic/shareable join link. Exact committed idempotency replay returns the original result.

post.summary: Resend one email-bound invitation and supersede its prior token
post.description: EMAIL-BOUND V3 contract; runtime NOT_IMPLEMENTED on main until the paired implementation is merged. Current ACTIVE Organization ADMIN with organization.memberships.manage may resend a pending invitation using its expected invitation version and reasonCode. Resend creates a new invitation ID and opaque token, marks the old invitation SUPERSEDED, preserves invitedEmail, and atomically records the invitation, idempotency result, allowlisted audit, and encrypted outbox intent. The API returns after commit; asynchronous email delivery may remain pending or retry while A7 is unavailable. The response never returns the token and does not claim delivery. A8 is an operational rollout concern. Exact committed idempotency replay returns the original acknowledgement.

post.summary: Accept a pending email-bound invitation and create one ACTIVE Membership
post.description: EMAIL-BOUND V3 contract; runtime NOT_IMPLEMENTED on main until the paired implementation is merged. Requires current authentication, valid CSRF, and idempotency. Server derives principal email, normalizes it with the IAM convention, and compares it with immutable invitation.invitedEmail; request-body email is not accepted. The invitation must be pending and unexpired. One transaction creates exactly one ACTIVE Membership, marks the invitation ACCEPTED, and records the required audit and idempotency result; any failure rolls the transaction back. No Role or Organization session is granted. Exact committed idempotency replay returns its original acknowledgement; another key cannot reuse an accepted invitation. Email delivery readiness is not a prerequisite. A8 is an operational rollout concern.

post.summary: Resolve one emailed invitation token without accepting it
post.description: EMAIL-BOUND V1 contract; runtime NOT_IMPLEMENTED. This read-only resolution is scoped to one cryptographically random token for one invitation. It may be called before login or registration and returns only invitation status, invited email, expiry, and Organization display name. It does not accept, mutate, create a Membership, or authorize joining. The server validates the token against its one-way hash. The client must not log or persist the raw token in localStorage; after reading a URL fragment, remove it from browser history and send it only in this no-store request body. The subsequent accept still requires authentication and an exact normalized principal-email match.

200.description: One invitation resolved, including effective EXPIRED status when applicable; no state change and no token returned.

404.description: Unknown or invalid token; no invitation/email details are returned.
